From: audit.team@kpmg.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 Type II: short access window & assertion letter request

Hi Priyom,

KPMG is scheduled to perform a remote review for Acme Payments. They have requested a 72-hour secure access window to download the SOC 2 Type II evidence bundle for the period Jan 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025. The customer (Acme) has asked that we:

- Provide a written access assertion letter naming the individuals who will have access and the purpose of access, signed by Redwood Legal or Security;
- Confirm whether the trust portal will allow auditor downloads or view-only;
- Share the shortlink/SSO one-time link and any IP allowlist requirements;
- Confirm the exact start/end timestamps for the 72-hour window (they prefer UTC).

Target window requested by Acme: 2026-12-07T14:00:00Z through 2026-12-10T14:00:00Z (UTC). If that is not possible, please propose an alternative within the same week.

Also note: Acme requires a brief statement that no historical logs outside the SOC 2 period will be exposed during the session.

Can you confirm by Friday 2026-12-04? We'll need the assertion letter to be signed and a shortlink provided at least 48 hours before the window opens.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
KPMG - Information Assurance
audit.team@kpmg.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II: short access window & assertion letter request

Kimberly / Marissa — looping you in.

Quick plan:
1) Kimberly, can you create a one-time SSO link with 72-hr expiry and restrict downloads to the auditor role? If portal can't enforce view-only vs download, we will enable download but watermark files and enable a strict download SLA (single ZIP, one-time).
2) I will draft the access assertion letter (standalone PDF) and request signature from Legal. Marissa, can you be the signatory (VP Legal) or suggest alternate?
3) We must confirm the audit period exposure: ensure the evidence index only includes artifacts dated within 2025 calendar year. No cross-period logs.
4) IP allowlist: ask Acme for their auditor IP ranges; otherwise we'll provide Redwood's ephemeral reviewer IP ranges and require outbound VPN.

I'll prepare the evidence index CSV and the assertion draft. Kimberly, target: provision link and shortlink by end-of-day 2026-12-04. Marissa, can you review and sign by 2026-12-06 EOD so we can meet the 48-hour requirement?

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II: short access window & assertion letter request

Got it — will do. Notes from infra: our portal supports three options: view-only, download-bundle (single zip), or per-file download. For this audit the simplest is a single ZIP with an audit watermark.

Action items for me:
- Create one-time SSO shortlink (72 hours) scoped to auditor role. Shortlink will be pre-authenticated and expire automatically.
- Generate an audit-only ZIP export containing the evidence index artifacts (filter by 2025 dates).
- Add a header in the portal page stating: "Access limited to artifacts dated within calendar year 2025; downloads are watermarked and logged."
- Provide ephemeral reviewer IP ranges: 34.81.120.0/24, 52.14.200.0/24 (these are temporary ranges assigned for this session).

I'll attach the shortlink text file and the preliminary evidence index for internal review. Priyom — confirming target to hand-off link + files on 2026-12-06 16:00:00 -0800.

—Kimberly
Director, Cloud Security Operations

Best,
